summary: E-stop from LiDAR watchdog during CPU starvation

findings.title: Proximate cause
findings.detail: The LiDAR watchdog fired after scans exceeded the 50 ms deadline.

findings.title: Root cause (kernel/scheduling layer)
findings.detail: A localization thread saturated core 3, starving the LiDAR driver callback until message age crossed the watchdog threshold.

findings.title: Contributing factor
findings.detail: No CPU affinity set for the localization thread.

findings.title: Contributing factor
findings.detail: Watchdog threshold leaves no margin for scheduling jitter.

findings.title: Evidence gap
findings.detail: No per-thread scheduler trace in the bundle.

recommendations: Pin the localization thread to a dedicated core and cap its rate.
Alert on lidar_msg_age_ms trending above 35 ms before the watchdog fires.
